testo: Hi, I'm Leo, the tech guy of the team! I wanted to remind you of a neat trick for when you consume products. When loading pantry items, you only think about full packages; the magic of Tenths (1/10, 3/10...) comes into play during Unloading! If you use half a bag of flour or a bit of milk, just log the tenths consumed and the app deducts that portion while keeping the rest. Your pantry stays accurate to the millimeter!
